Grant & Co OS uses this library only as a local Messages.app helper on the owner Mac. It is not an Apple-supported public iMessage API. Message contents never leave the machine. SIP stays on. There is no BlueBubbles, pypush, cloud, REST, WebSocket, or LAN listener.
